req.title: List returns empty array when db empty
req.statement: The system shall return an empty JSON array on GET /tasks/ when no tasks exist.
triggers: list returns empty array when db empty

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-033 requires GET /tasks/ to return an empty JSON array with HTTP 200 when no tasks exist. Three tests are designed: (1) positive EP test confirming exact 200 status and [] body on a clean DB; (2) negative NEG test confirming a client error (invalid query param) yields 4xx, not 2xx; (3) boundary BVA test confirming skip=0&limit=1 (minimum valid limit) still returns [] and exact 200 on empty DB, catching off-by-one mutations on the limit/skip guards. All tests use in-process FastAPI TestClient with a fresh SQLite in-memory DB injected via dependency override to guarantee isolation.

tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.main import app
from app.database import get_db, Base
from app import models

TEST_DB_URL = "sqlite:///./test_r033_pos.db"
engine = create_engine(TEST_DB_URL, connect_args={"check_same_thread": False})
TestingSessionLocal = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine)
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)

def override_get_db():
    db = TestingSessionLocal()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
client = TestClient(app)

def test_list_tasks_empty_db_returns_200_and_empty_array():
    response = client.get("/tasks/")
    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert response.json() == []
    assert "application/json" in response.headers["content-type"]

test_list_tasks_empty_db_returns_200_and_empty_array()
app.dependency_overrides.clear()
Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=engine)
import os; os.remove("./test_r033_pos.db") if os.path.exists("./test_r033_pos.db") else None

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.main import app
from app.database import get_db, Base

TEST_DB_URL = "sqlite:///./test_r033_bva.db"
engine = create_engine(TEST_DB_URL, connect_args={"check_same_thread": False})
TestingSessionLocal = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine)
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)

def override_get_db():
    db = TestingSessionLocal()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
client = TestClient(app)

def test_list_tasks_empty_db_with_min_valid_limit_returns_200_and_empty_array():
    response_min = client.get("/tasks/?skip=0&limit=1")
    assert response_min.status_code == 200
    assert response_min.json() == []
    response_skip_zero = client.get("/tasks/?skip=0&limit=100")
    assert response_skip_zero.status_code == 200
    assert response_skip_zero.json() == []
    response_invalid = client.get("/tasks/?limit=0")
    assert response_invalid.status_code == 422
